view-01.png.evidence: A few clear aircraft silhouettes survive the central cluster.
view-01.png.regressions: Overlapping labels and disk-shaped hits cover the deck; wake is abrupt.

view-02.png.evidence: Dark water and compact ripple accents frame the carrier; blue ring marks the plane.
view-02.png.regressions: Soft profiles obscure deck markings and the stern trail reads as one diffuse plume.

view-03.png.evidence: Runway markings, rocks and shoreline form clear landmarks.
view-03.png.regressions: Low contrast around the blue plane, repeated tree blobs and a nearly bare waterline.

view-04.png.evidence: Wet ground, raking light and shadows create strong volume; rain, smoke and tracer share the scene lighting.
view-04.png.regressions: Dark distant units and shaded infantry are difficult to identify quickly.

view-05.png.evidence: Isolated deck silhouette and markings are easy to locate.
view-05.png.regressions: Uniform deck has little volume; wake is a hard rectangle and labels sit across play space.

view-06.png.evidence: Hard deck outline and pale opposing planes contrast with the navy sea; pinpoints locate combat.
view-06.png.regressions: Bow ring intersects several aircraft and top HUD partly covers another.

view-07.png.evidence: Crisp runway arrows, roof shading and ring support clear navigation.
view-07.png.regressions: Soft verge transitions and isolated shore strokes still feel schematic.

view-08.png.evidence: Runway arrow and field boundaries organize the airfield.
view-08.png.regressions: Overlaid objective crosses the player, geometric trees and soft mottling dominate, no integrated shoreline effect.

view-09.png.evidence: Beach boundary and runway are immediately recognizable.
view-09.png.regressions: Field grid and mottling compete with the tiny player plane; little shoreline effect.

view-10.png.evidence: Crisp deck and tower hold the focus over layered fine ocean ripples.
view-10.png.regressions: The broad, soft stern trail has little internal variation and the plane overlaps deck markings.

view-11.png.evidence: Aircraft markings and sea contrast separate units at the perimeter.
view-11.png.regressions: Overlapping translucent disks and labels obscure the flat center deck; wake is a rectangular strip.

view-12.png.evidence: The ring, runway and three buildings remain distinct against the shore and textured sea.
view-12.png.regressions: Small assets soften and the thin foam breaks into separate strokes.

view-13.png.evidence: Aircraft silhouettes remain distinct away from the deck.
view-13.png.regressions: Center overlay, rounded smoke disks and hard-edged wake flatten the encounter.

view-14.png.evidence: Airframes and small warm impacts read against the dark ripple field.
view-14.png.regressions: Soft edges and bow overlap weaken precise tracking.

view-15.png.evidence: Clear deck linework, tower shadow and muted ripple accents keep focus on the carrier.
view-15.png.regressions: Plane still lies over deck lines, and stern trail shows little structure.

view-16.png.evidence: Runway and sand strip define the coast; aircraft contour is fairly clear.
view-16.png.regressions: Broad grass mottling and scattered offshore flecks undercut material scale.

view-17.png.evidence: Carrier tower and plane insignia establish targets clearly away from the bow.
view-17.png.regressions: Soft outlines and wake have little structure; bow overlap compromises player identification.

view-18.png.evidence: Crisp walls, material changes and tactical paths give rooms a clear structure.
view-18.png.regressions: Unit markers and routes can crowd the narrow hallway; effects are subdued.

view-19.png.evidence: Fog separates depth layers and vehicle flashes read against detailed autumn terrain.
view-19.png.regressions: Distant silhouettes recede into fog; unit status is not visible.

view-20.png.evidence: Crisp cream wings and warm flak remain legible over the quiet navy surface.
view-20.png.regressions: Center overlaps and top HUD conceal some airframes, with similar-looking impact bursts.

view-21.png.evidence: Ship placement and runway markings are straightforward.
view-21.png.regressions: Blurred bare deck, hard wake rectangle and text over the ship flatten the scene.

view-22.png.evidence: Fine ripples and smooth shallow-water color connect the beach to the open sea. The aircraft silhouette remains distinct.
view-22.png.regressions: Foam is sparse and some field patches have a generic rectangular shape.

view-23.png.evidence: Fine sea texture supports a clean carrier silhouette and crisp separation between light deck and dark tower.
view-23.png.regressions: The plane and bow overlap and the wake retains a single smooth plume shape.

view-24.png.evidence: Strong directional light and props give the market density and depth; colored routes identify activity.
view-24.png.regressions: Warm shadows hide figures among crowded stalls, and route lines cross nearby props.

view-25.png.evidence: Warm impact flecks and pale aircraft remain readable against the finely textured water.
view-25.png.regressions: The cockpit scale is difficult to judge in the bow cluster, and the upper banner partly masks an aircraft.

view-26.png.evidence: Sharp runway and roof lines organize the field.
view-26.png.regressions: Player blends against a blue roof, left hill looks faceted, and offshore flecks seem unrelated.

view-27.png.evidence: Runway stripes and geometric fields make navigation cues visible.
view-27.png.regressions: Plane is buried in overlaid text, hills and trees are faceted, and offshore flecks lack a shore interaction.

view-28.png.evidence: Deck geometry, tower and trail establish ship direction.
view-28.png.regressions: Blue plane merges into the narrow bow; broad teal swirls repeat.

view-29.png.evidence: Bright aircraft and orange impacts still separate from the restrained sea texture.
view-29.png.regressions: Deck overlaps and upper HUD occlusion reduce clarity of individual planes.

view-30.png.evidence: Clear deck markings and tower define direction and ship volume.
view-30.png.regressions: Aircraft is low contrast at the bow; offshore flecks resemble stray particles.

view-31.png.evidence: Orange bursts retain contrast on a richly textured dark sea around the crowded carrier.
view-31.png.regressions: Soft outlines and overlap reduce recognition around the deck. Uppermost planes remain covered by the HUD.

view-32.png.evidence: Thin deck detail, clear aircraft profiles off the deck and small orange impacts keep the busy formation legible over finer water.
view-32.png.regressions: Several aircraft overlap near the bow and others pass behind the HUD.

view-33.png.evidence: Hangars and runway form a clear airfield; tree shadows add anchoring.
view-33.png.regressions: Plane overlaps a roof, soft foliage edges and faceted hill clash with broad ground mottling.

view-34.png.evidence: Carrier tower shadow, fine water crests and warm hit markers give the composition distinct layers.
view-34.png.regressions: Bow ring crosses other silhouettes and the upper HUD partly conceals a plane.

view-35.png.evidence: Wing markings remain distinct in isolated positions.
view-35.png.regressions: Soft central silhouettes, disk effects and inline labels muddy the fight.

view-36.png.evidence: Marked planes stand out on the teal sea and deck markings survive the crowd.
view-36.png.regressions: Effects read as scattered flecks, and selected plane is harder to find in the cluster.

view-37.png.evidence: Ring, runway arrow and beach shelf retain their forms at reduced detail.
view-37.png.regressions: Softens smaller plane/building details, and short foam marks read as disconnected strokes.

view-38.png.evidence: Sharp wings, ship shadow and deck lines give a legible air-and-sea composition.
view-38.png.regressions: Closest aircraft overlaps the bow and pale flecks add competing accents.

view-39.png.evidence: Hard coastline and runway edge organize the frame.
view-39.png.regressions: Tiny overlaid labels and plane compete with the field grid; isolated white flecks distract at sea.

view-40.png.evidence: Dark aircraft silhouettes and layered rocky terrain converge on a high-energy tracer and fire burst.
view-40.png.regressions: The bright burst occludes several nearby units; overlapping dark forms are harder to parse.

view-41.png.evidence: Ring and pale shallows separate aircraft, terrain and sea; water accents stay subdued.
view-41.png.regressions: The soft plane outline and offshore foam fragments limit material definition.

view-42.png.evidence: Aircraft ring, shadowed trees and pale shallows remain readable over the detailed coast.
view-42.png.regressions: Airframe detail is soft and foam stays intermittent.

view-43.png.evidence: Runway geometry, roof shading and broad shore-to-sea color shift make the base easy to place.
view-43.png.regressions: Yard boundaries are diffuse and foam still sits offshore in disconnected streaks.

view-44.png.evidence: Clear aircraft silhouette, grounded foliage and teal shelf establish a clean coast.
view-44.png.regressions: Broken foam and some visually rectangular grass plots remain.

view-45.png.evidence: Distinct aircraft markings, hull and quiet smoke preserve much of the formation.
view-45.png.regressions: Center remains crowded; pale wave pattern and soft small details limit definition.
